facts.fact: The Mountain Burger case study was published on May 2, 2025.
The Mountain Burger case study page was last updated on September 17, 2026.
The Mountain Burger TV ad invited viewers to visit its Bend location at 2747 Northwest Crossing Drive.
facts.quote: Visit us today at 2747 Northwest Crossing Drive in Bend.

facts.fact: Mountain Burger reported that within days of launching its campaign, new customers said they 'saw us on TV'; the page gives no count of these customers.
facts.quote: Within days of launching our campaign, we started seeing new faces coming in saying they 'saw us on TV.'

facts.fact: The Adwave page states that the restaurant's customer feedback does not establish how many visits were caused by advertising or a percentage increase in sales.
facts.quote: It does not establish how many visits were caused by advertising or a percentage increase in sales.
